question: Which mantra syllables are classified as masculine and suited to subjugation and expulsion rites?
premises: Huṃ and phaṭ are named syllables.
They are associated with subjugation and expulsion rites.
inference: Huṃ and phaṭ are declared masculine and used in subjugation and expulsion rites.
plain_english: Huṃ and phaṭ are declared masculine and are used in rites of subjugation and expulsion.
